title: Finance Office Schedule of Security Holds, Waivers and Replacement Values, Equipment Rental and Demo
content:
## Holds, waivers and replacement values, Equipment Rental and Demo

Each package of the Equipment Rental and Demo line carries a security hold sized to the package, a damage waiver price and excess, the amount charged where kit is not brought back at all, and the number of business days after check-in within which the hold is released.

| Package | Security hold | Waiver offered | Waiver, per day | Waiver excess | Replacement value | Hold release period, business days |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Junior Ski & Board Rental | 100.00 USD | yes | 5.00 USD | 25.00 USD | 420.00 USD | 3 |
| Basic Ski & Board Rental | 150.00 USD | yes | 7.00 USD | 50.00 USD | 640.00 USD | 3 |
| Sport Ski & Board Rental | 250.00 USD | yes | 9.00 USD | 50.00 USD | 890.00 USD | 5 |
| Performance Ski & Board Rental | 400.00 USD | yes | 12.00 USD | 75.00 USD | 1290.00 USD | 5 |
| Demo Ski & Board Rental | 650.00 USD | yes | 15.00 USD | 100.00 USD | 1650.00 USD | 7 |
| Season-Long Lease Package | 350.00 USD | yes | 79.00 USD | 100.00 USD | 890.00 USD | 10 |

### The figures defined

The security hold is the hold in USD placed against the agreement when kit is set aside. The waiver price is the price in USD per day of the damage waiver on the package, and the waiver excess the amount in USD the guest still bears on a damage claim where the waiver was taken. The replacement value is the amount in USD charged where kit from the package is not brought back at all. The hold release period is the number of business days after check-in within which the hold is released.

### The figures read across the line

Across the five day-hire packages the hold rises with the value of the kit, from 100.00 USD on the Junior Ski & Board Rental to 650.00 USD on the Demo Ski & Board Rental, and the replacement value rises with it, from 420.00 USD to 1650.00 USD. The Season-Long Lease Package sits apart from that run: its hold of 350.00 USD stands between the Sport and Performance figures, its replacement value of 890.00 USD is the same as the Sport Ski & Board Rental's, and its waiver, priced by the day like every other waiver on the line, stands at 79.00 USD a day against the day-hire packages' 5.00, 7.00, 9.00, 12.00 and 15.00 USD.

The excess climbs in steps of 25.00 USD: 25.00 USD on the Junior package, 50.00 USD on the Basic and Sport packages, 75.00 USD on the Performance package and 100.00 USD on the Demo and Season-Long Lease packages. The release period never shortens from one package to the next, though it does not move in even steps: 3 business days on the Junior and Basic packages, 5 on the Sport and Performance packages, 7 on the Demo package and 10 on the Season-Long Lease Package.

### Points of judgement on this schedule

**Where the waiver is offered.** The damage waiver is offered on every package of the Equipment Rental and Demo line; no package of the line is written without one available against it.

**A finding on Demo kit (hypothetical).** The Demo Ski & Board Rental carries a hold of 650.00 USD, an excess of 100.00 USD and a replacement value of 1650.00 USD, so the hold standing against a Demo agreement is smaller than the amount charged for kit that never comes back.
